QUOTE: `not_indexed`: extensions the index holds but did not read (`.rs=2`, `.toml=2`, `.sql=1`, extensionless `=3`, and others).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The item requires naming file types that were in scope and produced no rows. The answer instead names files that were not read (`not_indexed`), which is the opposite category, and never describes in-scope types that returned zero rows.
